title: Wash It All Away
native: 綺麗にしてもらえますか。
synopsis:
For the past two years, cheerful and hardworking Kinme Wakana has run a small laundry shop in the seaside hot springs town of Atami. As she goes about her quiet days, Wakana finds herself drawn into the bittersweet, heartwarming stories of the people around her.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: You Can Count on Kinme
episodes.synopsis:
Kinme Wakana runs a dry cleaning business in the city of Atami, where she leads a peaceful life.

episodes.title: We're Proud of Our Natural Hot Spring
episodes.synopsis:

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.synopsis:

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: A Personal Request from Kinme
episodes.synopsis:

episodes.title: I Have a Feeling...
episodes.synopsis:
